subject: Medford Community Housing Fellsway West Loan Approval
overview: The Trust approved a $100,000 loan to Medford Community Housing for project overruns and reviewed research on regional downpayment assistance programs. Members also discussed fundraising strategies and planned a community housing resource fair for June.

items.title: Medford Community Housing Fellsway West Loan
items.summary: Approved a $100,000 loan to Medford Community Housing for soft costs and utility-related overruns at the Fellsway West property after negotiating down the contractor's initial claims.

items.title: Fundraising and Housing Resource Fair
items.summary: Advanced plans for a housing resource fair in early June to provide educational materials to residents and finalized the design of a fundraising fact sheet.

items.title: Downpayment Assistance Research
items.summary: Evaluated regional downpayment assistance models from Cambridge and Boston and discussed the potential for establishing an equity buy-down program for low-income homeowners.

items.title: Financial Update and Administrative Matters
items.summary: Reviewed the transition of Trust funds from long-term investment accounts to accessible special revenue accounts and agreed to an August meeting recess.
